startUrls.title: Website URLs
startUrls.description: Homepage (or any page) of each site to check. The crawler stays on the same domain.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per site
maxPagesPerSite.description: Stop after this many HTML pages per site. You are charged per page crawled.

checkExternalLinks.title: Check external links
checkExternalLinks.description: Also verify links pointing to other websites (each URL is checked once).

checkResources.title: Check images, scripts & stylesheets
checkResources.description: Verify ,

includeWorkingLinks.title: Include working links in output
includeWorkingLinks.description: Off = only broken and blocked links (smaller dataset). On = every checked URL.

includeSubdomains.title: Treat subdomains as internal
includeSubdomains.description: Crawl blog.example.com when starting from example.com.

maxDepth.title: Max crawl depth
maxDepth.description: Clicks away from the start URL.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel page fetches. Keep low to be gentle on the site.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per request (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for each HTTP request before treating the link as timed out.
